about: install-pwsh.sh installs the versions requirements-system.txt names. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE install-pwsh.sh tests/test_install_pwsh.py tests/mutants/jpt-pins-on-install-pwsh.json

mutants.name: the latest module, not its pin
mutants.target: pwsh present: the module installed at the manifest's pin

mutants.name: a fixed release, not the manifest's
mutants.target: no pwsh: the manifest's release, linux x64

mutants.name: the new pwsh not put on GITHUB_PATH
mutants.target: no pwsh: put on GITHUB_PATH for the next step

mutants.name: a missing manifest line read as empty
edits:
echo "install-pwsh: no '$tool' line with column $col in requirements-system.txt" >&2
    return 1

echo "install-pwsh: no '$tool' line with column $col in requirements-system.txt" >&2
    return 0
mutants.target: no pwsh line: exit 1, naming it, and nothing run

mutants.name: the download is not checked against its hash
mutants.target: hash mismatch: exit 1, says so, nothing unpacked or left, no module install

mutants.name: the Gallery trusted again
mutants.target: pwsh present: the Gallery's trust setting is not touched
